newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse board resets presidency meeting.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse board resets presidency meeting.

text.p: The board of governors of the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) has rescheduled for Friday a meeting to discuss candidates for bourse president, a board member said on Wednesday.
The meeting had been expected on Wednesday, when it was to draft a list of possible replacements to Vitaliano Nanagas, who resigned abruptly at the weekend.
"There was an urgent matter that had to be attended by some of the other members of the board, hence the meeting today was postponed," said Harry Liu, PSE treasurer and board member.
Ramon Garcia Jr, another member of the PSE board, told Reuters the board would discuss criteria for choosing the next bourse president as well as policy directions for the stock exchange.
Liu said it would be the first meeting of the newly-elected board of governors for the year. The board was elected on Saturday.
Nanagas resigned on Saturday following a wave of resignations of senior bourse officials that were triggered by "irreconcilable differences", the exchange said.
